# LibreDB Studio — Full Documentation for LLMs

> LibreDB Studio is a modern, AI-powered, open-source web-based SQL IDE designed for cloud-native teams. It provides a lightweight, high-performance, enterprise-secure database management experience with SSO support and multi-model AI integration.

## Product Information
- **Name:** LibreDB Studio
- **Type:** Web-based SQL IDE
- **License:** MIT License (100% free and open source)
- **Website:** https://libredb.org
- **Live Demo JWT:** https://app.libredb.org
- **Live Demo OIDC:** https://demo.libredb.org
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/libredb/libredb-studio
- **Privacy Policy:** https://libredb.org/privacy-policy

---

## Supported Databases

LibreDB Studio supports 7+ databases out of the box:

| Database | Type |
|----------|------|
| PostgreSQL | Relational |
| MySQL | Relational |
| SQLite | Relational (embedded) |
| Oracle Database | Relational (enterprise) |
| Microsoft SQL Server | Relational (enterprise) |
| MongoDB | Document (NoSQL) |
| Redis | Key-Value (NoSQL) |

---

## Key Features

### Monaco SQL IDE
Professional SQL editor powered by the same Monaco engine used in VS Code. Features include syntax highlighting, IntelliSense autocomplete, multi-tab editing, and keyboard shortcuts.

### NL2SQL Copilot
Convert natural language questions into SQL queries using AI. Supports multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and local Ollama models.

### AI Query Safety
AI-powered SQL analysis that reviews queries before execution, warns about potentially destructive operations, and suggests optimizations.

### Visual EXPLAIN Plans
Visualize query execution plans as interactive diagrams. Identify bottlenecks, missing indexes, and optimization opportunities at a glance.

### Interactive ER Diagrams
Auto-generated Entity-Relationship diagrams from your database schema. Explore table relationships, foreign keys, and data models visually.

### AI Data Profiler
Automated column-level data profiling powered by AI. Get statistical summaries, data quality insights, and pattern detection.

### ORM Code Generator
Generate ORM model code from your database schema. Supports popular frameworks and languages.

### Test Data Generator
AI-assisted realistic test data generation. Create meaningful sample data for development and testing.

### AI Query Autopilot
Automated multi-step query workflows powered by AI agents. Let AI handle complex database exploration tasks.

### DBA Monitoring Dashboard
Real-time database health monitoring. Track active connections, query performance, table sizes, and system metrics.

### Database Documentation
Auto-generate comprehensive documentation for your database schema, including table descriptions, column details, and relationship maps.

### SSO / Single Sign-On
Enterprise-grade authentication via OIDC. Compatible with Auth0, Keycloak, Okta, Azure AD, and any OIDC-compliant provider.

### Enterprise Security
Role-based access control, audit logging, and secure connection management. Designed for enterprise compliance requirements.

### Data Masking
Protect sensitive data with configurable masking rules. Automatically mask PII, financial data, and other sensitive columns.

### Pro Data Grid
High-performance data grid with sorting, filtering, pagination, and inline editing. Handle large datasets efficiently.

### Mobile Ready
Fully responsive design that works on tablets and mobile devices. Manage your databases from anywhere.

---

## Deployment Options

### Docker (Recommended)
```bash
docker-compose up -d
```

### Manual Installation
```bash
git clone https://github.com/libredb/libredb-studio.git
cd libredb-studio
bun install
bun run dev
```

### Configuration
Key environment variables:
- `JWT_SECRET` — Secret key for JWT authentication
- `LLM_PROVIDER` — AI provider (ollama, openai, gemini, claude)
- `LLM_BASE_URL` — AI provider endpoint URL
- `LLM_MODEL` — AI model name
- `OIDC_ISSUER` — OIDC provider issuer URL (for SSO)
- `OIDC_CLIENT_ID` — OIDC client ID
- `OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` — OIDC client secret

### One-Click Deploy
- **Render:** Deploy directly from GitHub
- **Koyeb:** One-click deployment available

### System Requirements
- Node.js 18+ or Bun runtime
- Docker (optional, for containerized deployment)
- Modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is LibreDB Studio free?
Yes. LibreDB Studio is 100% free and open source under the MIT License. There are no paid tiers, no premium features, and no usage limits. You can use it for personal, commercial, or enterprise purposes without any restrictions.

### Can I self-host LibreDB Studio?
Absolutely. LibreDB Studio is designed for self-hosting. You can run it on your own servers using Docker, Kubernetes, or directly with Node.js/Bun. Your data never leaves your infrastructure.

### Which AI providers are supported?
LibreDB Studio supports multiple AI providers: OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-3.5), Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and local models via Ollama. You can switch between providers or use local models for complete data privacy.

### Is my database data sent to AI providers?
Only when you explicitly use AI features (NL2SQL, data profiling, etc.) is schema metadata sent to the configured AI provider. You can use Ollama for 100% local AI processing where no data leaves your server.

### Does LibreDB Studio support SSO?
Yes. LibreDB Studio supports OIDC-based Single Sign-On compatible with Auth0, Keycloak, Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, and any OIDC-compliant identity provider.

### How does LibreDB compare to pgAdmin or DBeaver?
LibreDB Studio is a modern, web-based alternative with AI capabilities. Unlike pgAdmin (PostgreSQL-only) or DBeaver (desktop-based), LibreDB runs in any browser, supports 7+ databases including NoSQL, and includes AI-powered features like NL2SQL and query optimization.

### Can I use LibreDB Studio on mobile?
Yes. LibreDB Studio features a fully responsive, mobile-first design. You can manage your databases from any device with a modern web browser.

### What are the minimum requirements?
You need Node.js 18+ (or Bun) and a modern web browser. For Docker deployment, you just need Docker and Docker Compose. No additional dependencies are required.

---

## Tech Stack
- **Backend:** Java 21, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Monaco Editor, TailwindCSS
- **AI:** Multi-model support (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Ollama)
- **Auth:** OIDC / OAuth 2.0
- **Deployment:** Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions CI/CD
